name: Garrya Tongsai Bay Samui
short_description: A 5-star boutique resort in Bophut set on 28 acres wrapped around a private bay with its own exclusive beach front.
ai_summary: Garrya Tongsai Bay Samui sits in Bophut, on Ko Samui's north coast, spread across 28 acres wrapped around a private bay with an exclusive beach front, per its own Accor listing. The resort is positioned as an upscale, nature-focused retreat with views over the Gulf of Thailand. No aggregate ALL guest rating was shown on the hotel's page at the time of research.
